correctness.rationale: Radial diagonalization and exactly specified Jacobian give beta-prime eigenvalues. The universal Cantor CDF inequality follows inductively, and integration by parts yields rigorous uniform bounds L_{m,1}<0.624 and sup_{k>=2}L_{m,k}<0.600. Exact rational Jensen lower bound for L_{m,0} exceeds 0.629 for every m>=2, proving strict vacuum maximality. Uniform tail estimates and weak convergence of shifted Cantor measures justify the exact limiting constant. A standalone checker reproduces rational and finite-stage identities; computations supplement, not replace, proof.
